caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned wooden tool, positioned vertically in the center of a cream-colored background. The tool has a carved, turned wooden handle at the top, which is wider and slightly rounded. From the handle, the body of the tool appears to be an angular, zigzag form composed of three main segments joined at sharp right angles, with each segment rendered to show wood grain and texture in varying shades of brown. On the lower left portion of the tool, there is a small, tapered projection that may serve as a functional part of the tool. Near the bottom right-hand corner of the image, the name "David S. De Vaut" is written in a small, cursive script. There are no other objects or distinguishing marks on the otherwise plain and lightly marked background.
title: Brace - For Drilling
